figures.invite.text:
Are you in a colla (festival group) for gegants (giant figures) or bestiari (festive beasts)? Want your town in the game? Tell us about your figure and where it’s from. Send photos, videos or its dance music if you have them.

The game is open source: you can help code it on GitHub too.
